name: In the Shade of Lilies
source:
From the moment we are born, we are instilled with certain ideas regarding the limits of realism and fantasy. But what is the exact difference between this? Is there even one? And more importantly, do you still think you can tell the real from the unreal?

[From [url=https://madnessway.itch.io/in-the-shade-of-lilies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我們從出生起，就被灌輸某些關於現實與幻想界限的觀念。可是，兩者之間到底有什麼區別？真的存在區別嗎？更重要的是，你現在還分得清真實與虛幻嗎？

[來源：[url=https://madnessway.itch.io/in-the-shade-of-lilies]Itch.io[/url]]
